eq_note: exhaustive Wp is exponential in the extra-state bound (Chow 1978; Fujiwara et al. 1991) -> ~145k episodes at depth 2, infeasible over the timeout-probed net.Pipe; randomized Wp samples the same test-word space to a fixed budget, the standard practice for real protocol SULs (de Ruiter & Poll USENIX'15; Fiterau-Brostean et al). Single-step divergences are caught deterministically by TTT membership queries, not this oracle.
seed: identities fixed (sul/identity.go: driver 0x11, SUT 0x22 byte-repeated Ed25519 seeds); ML-KEM-768/X25519 ephemeral material is UNSEEDED real crypto/mlkem/crypto/ecdh randomness -- see identity_determinism
identity_determinism: fixed Ed25519 seeds for both the driver and the SUT identity (sul/identity.go); ML-KEM/X25519 ephemeral material is real crypto/mlkem and crypto/ecdh randomness (never overridden), which is safe because every SUL output is abstracted to a frame-type/error-code symbol, not raw bytes
